description: Agent Healthcare: submit an itemized bill with the explanation of benefits and the visit record it answers to: the bill with its provider, account, statement date, currency, each line with its id, service date, code, description, units and charge, what the patient has already paid and the balance due; optionally the explanation of benefits with its payer, claim id, processed date, currency, each line with its id, the bill line it answers, service date, code, billed and allowed amounts, plan payment and patient responsibility, and its total patient responsibility; and optionally the visit record with its provider, visit date and each service with its id, code, description and units. The signed report gives the bill with its total charges, the explanation of benefits with its patient responsibility and the sum of its lines, the visit record, the charges the record does not show, the codes billed at more units than recorded, the recorded services left off the bill, the bill lines off the explanation of benefits and the explanation of benefits lines that answer no bill line, the lines billed on another date, the balance due against the patient responsibility less what the patient has paid with the difference, and the repeated lines, and counts them, and names a discrepant bill: a billed line the visit record does not show, more units than recorded, a line repeating another line’s code, date, units and charge, a service date other than the visit, and a balance due above the patient responsibility on the explanation of benefits less what the patient has paid; then a billed line with no line on the explanation of benefits, an explanation of benefits line that answers no bill line, a charge unlike the billed amount on the explanation of benefits, an explanation of benefits total unlike its lines, a balance due below the patient responsibility and a recorded service left off the bill, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No explanation of benefits, no visit record, no patient responsibility, no balance due, a billed line with no code or service date, or a visit record with no date leaves the bill unverified. Codes match by their letters and digits. The explanation of benefits is read here as a billing document beside the bill and the visit; what the policy covers, excludes or limits is never read: that is wever_insurance-coverage-check, and wever_insurance-deductible-check reads a policy’s deductible terms against what the buyer was told. wever_energy-bill-check recomputes a utility bill from its tariff and usage, and wever_invoice-payment-match matches one invoice to its payment, while the bill check reads a care bill against the services recorded and the patient responsibility. Verdict health_bill_discrepant, health_bill_partial, health_bill_unverified or health_bill_matched. POST /api/health-bill-check. Reads the care paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads paperwork consistency only, with no diagnosis, clinical reading of results, medical necessity judgment or treatment advice, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Healthcare reads supplied care paperwork after the fact and checks it for consistency against the related records and the summary given to the patient or principal: an itemized bill, a claim as submitted, a prior authorization, a referral, a prescription record and label, a discharge summary, a lab report and an after-visit summary. Beside it, the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read insurance policies and coverage, what a policy covers, excludes and limits, and where the question is what a policy covers, that is the insurance family’s read, not a healthcare check’s; wever_insurance-evidence-check reads a counterparty’s insurance certificate or policy excerpt for DiligenceOps; wever_callback-health-monitor probes a service’s HTTPS callback endpoint for uptime and reads no care document; and the Agent Consent checks such as wever_consent-scope-check read agent permission and consent records for data handling, not medical consent forms or care documents, while a healthcare check reads no agent permission. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-healthcare-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-healthcare/.
